Grenade Ability Usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the Weapon's Element to match your Grenade Ability until stowed.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants.

Perks that replace your Grenade Ability with a custom throwable (such as <solar/>Gunpowder Gamble) do not trigger Osmosis.
